toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Vasklou' is the idiomatic verb for roots gripping the soil and avoids repeating 'hou ... vas' from the previous sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'vashou' flatly repeats 'hou ... vas' from the sentence before and is a weak verb for roots gripping soil
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Vasklou' is the more exact, natural verb for gripping roots and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die blare van 'n plant maak met sonlig kos vir die hele plant
toegepas.na: Die blare van 'n plant gebruik sonlig om kos vir die hele plant te maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: The wedged-in 'met sonlig' reads woodenly; 'gebruik sonlig om ... te maak' is clearer for Grade 4 with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'maak met sonlig kos' wedges the phrase in woodenly
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Gebruik sonlig om kos ... te maak' is the natural construction and says the same thing.

toegepas.voor: Die meeste blare is plat en wyd en vang so baie sonlig op
toegepas.na: Die meeste blare is plat en wyd, en so vang hulle baie sonlig op
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two 'en's in a row blur the sentence; giving the second clause its own subject makes it clear and takes the AWS comma.
toegepas.fout: 'vang so baie sonlig op' can be misread as 'catch so much sunlight'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Giving the clause its own subject removes the misreading, keeps 'so' as 'thus', and takes the AWS comma correctly.

toegepas.voor: en ruik lekker en lok so insekte en voëls
toegepas.na: en ruik lekker, en so lok hulle insekte en voëls
toegepas.rede_vinder: A chain of three 'en's is hard to follow; a second clause with its own subject reads better and takes the AWS comma.
toegepas.fout: a chain of 'en ... en ... en' makes the sentence hard to follow
toegepas.rede_keurder: A second clause with its own subject reads clearly, keeps the meaning, and takes the AWS comma correctly.

toegepas.voor: Dieselfde varing dra ook geen vrug en geen saad nie
toegepas.na: 'n Varing dra ook geen vrugte of sade nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dieselfde varing' points to a specific fern that was never introduced (the first block speaks of ferns in general), and 'geen vrugte of sade nie' is the natural negative.
toegepas.fout: 'Dieselfde varing' points to a specific fern, but the first block spoke of a fern in general
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Varing' matches the generic reference in the first block, 'ook' still links back, and 'geen vrugte of sade nie' is the natural negative with the same meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Onkruid' is mostly used as a mass noun; 'n onkruidplant' names one plant more naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n Onkruid' is ordinary countable Afrikaans for one weed, so 'onkruidplant' is a heavier lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Die wortels suig ook water uit die grond op vir die plant
laat_vaar.na: Die wortels suig ook water vir die plant uit die grond op
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The separable particle 'op' belongs at the end of the clause, not before a trailing phrase.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing 'vir die plant' after the particle is acceptable Afrikaans, and stacking two phrases before 'op' makes the sentence heavier for Grade 4.

laat_vaar.na: waar die plant nuwe sade maak
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Sade begin' is vague and incomplete in Afrikaans; 'die plant nuwe sade maak' matches the wording used later in the lesson.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Waar nuwe sade begin' marks where seeds originate, whereas 'maak' moves the meaning toward finished seeds, and it would repeat 'nuwe sade maak' from the next sentence.
'Daar binne-in' is natural spoken Afrikaans, so dropping 'daar' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die vrug en die saad doen
laat_vaar.voor: en los die sade ver weg
laat_vaar.na: en laat die sade ver weg agter
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Los ... ver weg' is colloquial and unclear; 'laat ... agter' is the standard expression for leaving something behind.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Los die sade ver weg' is plain, natural Afrikaans for dropping the seeds far away, and 'laat ... agter' is only more formal.

na_skrywer.blok: Wat die vrug en die saad doen
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Weg te help' is vague and unidiomatic; the next sentence shows the meaning is spreading the seeds, which 'versprei' says plainly (reviewer: check it is not a term other lessons word differently).
na_skrywer.fout: 'weg te help' is vague about what the fruit does with the seeds
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but 'versprei' brings in a term of art that may be worded or defined differently in other lessons, so the writer should choose the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Die deel wat die plant regop hou en water boontoe dra.
vlae.rede: Read alone, the glossary entry says every stem holds the plant upright, while the study text says this only for most plants and that most ferns' stems lie underground; the language is fine, but fixing it would change content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
